verdict.rationale: An official Python SDK is documented for partition, enrich, chunk and embed calls (unstructured-docs-23, unstructured-docs-4), and for creating, updating, running and deleting workflows (unstructured-docs-7). A Jobs API exists for triggering and monitoring runs (unstructured-docs-5), but the evidence names only Python and REST clients, with no TypeScript SDK. Missing for 10: any TypeScript SDK, evidence that the SDK is typed, explicit SDK coverage of structured data extraction and the jobs endpoints, documented sensible defaults, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
